Sign

M197

Wells W575 · Unclassified

Appears in 55 texts (60 uses), mostly on seals at Mohenjo-daro; found at the start, middle and end of texts. In the larger ICIT corpus its Wells equivalent W575 is in 67 texts, including at Dholavira.

Counts are distinct texts in the Mahadevan 1977 concordance (a text repeated on many moulded tablets counts once). 60 objects in all carry it.
